title: Four-Layer Cathedral Schema
subtitle: Knowledge, Planning, Teaching, Learning layers unified in 13 tables
key_concept: A relational schema that models the entire coaching workflow from raw knowledge to student learning
visual_metaphor: A cathedral cross-section with four distinct levels: crypt (Knowledge), nave (Planning), choir (Teaching), spire (Learning), connected by amber-lit staircases
highlights: Designed for both drill banks and coaching sessions
why_it_matters: First time the entire coaching domain is captured in a single, coherent data model
zone_change: New territory: Unified Schema — previously separate drill banks now connected under one roof
